name: wolfpack-tapeball
description: Wolfpack Tape Ball League — cricket tournament scoring platform (umpire + public web, event-sourced)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,api,umpire,web -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm run test:watch -w shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w umpire-app" "npm run dev -w web-app"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n api,umpire,web -c green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w umpire-app" "npm run dev -w web-app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w umpire-app && npm run build -w web-app
